item.title: Monogamy of Entanglement Bounds and Improved Approximation Algorithms for Qudit Hamiltonians
item.description:
We establish new entanglement monogamy bounds for two-local qudit Hamiltonians and certify ground state energy using sum-of-squares proofs. A simple matching-based algorithm achieves better-than-random approximations, including a 0.595 guarantee for qubits, outperforming prior results on bounded-degree graphs.

item.title: Approximation Algorithms for Quantum Max-d-Cut
item.description:
The Quantum Max-d-Cut problem seeks quantum states maximizing antisymmetric subspace energy in d-dimensional systems, generalizing Max-d-Cut. We provide a polynomial-time approximation algorithm with performance guarantees and prove its tightness using a gap instance for d≥3.

item.title: Quantifying Gerrymandering with Simulated Annealing
item.description:
We apply Markov Chain Monte Carlo with Simulated Annealing to detect gerrymandering, showing it effectively generates representative voting distributions. Results on Texas demonstrate its speed and reliability in identifying bias in districting plans, offering a powerful analytical tool.
